The south ridge route is best walked clockwise in dry weather. Above
the tree line the path splits at the cairns: the upper line is shorter
and exposed, the lower line drops to a stream that runs fast after
rain. Took the lower line last Sunday and it was knee-deep at the
crossing, which was worth it for the view down the whole valley on the
descent.

Six hours door to door with a proper stop at the summit. The forecast
window held until late afternoon and the way down was dry.
